Dilengkapi arsitektur custom skills berjenjang: antislop sebagai Hard Gate UI/UX (kontras WCAG AA, anti-klaim palsu), ai-engineer-blueprint (standar 5 pilar proyek AI), serta python-testing-patterns.
description_en: Upgraded personal AI engineering environment migrating from legacy proxy routing to direct Google AI Studio (Gemini API Pro) via the official google-genai SDK. Enforces automated UI/UX anti-slop hard gates (WCAG AA contrast, zero fabricated claims), the 5-Pillar AI Engineer Blueprint standard, and pytest evaluation harnesses.
architecture_id:
1. Google AI Studio (Gemini API Pro) & Official SDK

  • SDK Standar: Menggunakan google-genai (Python) dan @google/genai (TypeScript/JS) secara langsung untuk text generation, structured output, function calling, dan multimodal analysis.
  • Model Tiering: Gemini 2.5 Pro untuk penalaran kompleks/arsitektur dan Gemini 2.5 Flash untuk inferensi cepat berlatensi rendah.

2. Custom Skill Hierarchy & Hard Gates

  • antislop Suite (Primary Gate): Menegakkan 40 aturan kualitas UI/copywriting, verifikasi rasio kontras WCAG AA, dan pengiriman berbasis bukti.
  • ai-engineer-blueprint: Standar wajib 5 pilar untuk setiap proyek AI (Fungsi Teknis, Nilai Bisnis, Target Pengguna, Indikator Awam 10 Detik, dan Matriks Evaluasi/Ablasi).
  • Testing & Frontend Standards: Integrasi python-testing-patterns (pytest fixtures/mocking) dan vercel-react-best-practices.
architecture_en:
1. Google AI Studio (Gemini API Pro) & Official SDK

  • Official SDKs: Direct integration with google-genai (Python) and @google/genai (TypeScript/JS) for structured outputs, tool calling, embeddings, and multimodal workflows.
  • Model Tiering: Gemini 2.5 Pro for complex reasoning/coding and Gemini 2.5 Flash for low-latency production pipelines.

2. Custom Skill Hierarchy & Hard Gates

  • antislop Suite (Primary Gate): Enforces 40 strict UI/copywriting rules, WCAG AA contrast verification, and evidence-backed delivery.
  • ai-engineer-blueprint: Mandatory 5-Pillar AI project evaluation standard (Technical Pipeline, Business Utility, Target User, 10s Layman Proof, and Evaluation/Ablation Matrix).
  • Testing & Frontend Standards: Integrated python-testing-patterns (pytest fixtures/mocking) and vercel-react-best-practices.
